name: gravity-golf-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android wrapper for Gravity Golf

scripts.generate:native-assets: npm run build:assets && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --pwaNoAppleFetch true
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.add:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios --packagemanager SPM
scripts.add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
